_doc: OrcaSlicer presets for platform/parts/slice-check.py --slicer orca (gpu-batch-docker#13): the ones the user prints the Neptune with (picked 2026-11-07), exported from ~/.var/app/com.orcaslicer.OrcaSlicer/config/OrcaSlicer/user/default/ with print_host blanked. They hold only overrides; `inherits` resolves against the vendors' system profiles of the Orca that runs (2.5.0), which slice-check installs from that Orca's own resources. support_check is applied to the process only: supports on everywhere for overhangs flatter than 45 deg, as in petg-0.4-0.2.ini; the user's preset leaves supports off and turns them on per plate.
filament: filament/E RPETG Red - MMU - cht-mze + bimetal.json
